books.title: The Secret Treehouse
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Behind Maya's house stood a giant oak tree. High in its branches, Maya and her brother built a treehouse.
They hammered wooden boards, painted a sign that said 'Maya and Leo's Club', and hung a rope ladder.
Every afternoon they climbed up with books, biscuits, and a pair of binoculars to watch the birds.
One day they found a tiny wooden box hidden under a floorboard. Inside was a map of the garden.
The map led them to a spot under the rose bush, where they dug up a tin full of shiny marbles.
Maya and Leo kept the marbles in the treehouse. It was their secret treasure, and the treehouse was their favourite place in the world.

books.title: The Friendly Dragon
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: In a village at the foot of a mountain lived a dragon called Dara. Unlike other dragons, Dara was kind and gentle.
Dara loved to help the villagers. She carried heavy baskets, lit the lanterns with her warm breath, and warmed the school on cold days.
But some villagers were afraid of her. 'Dragons breathe fire!' they whispered. 'She might be dangerous.'
One stormy night, a fire started in the old barn. The villagers shouted for help, and Dara flew down at once.
Dara scooped up water from the river in her great wings and poured it over the flames until the fire was out.
From that night on, nobody was afraid of Dara. She was the hero of the village, and the children loved to ride on her back.

books.title: The Magic Backpack
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: On his first day of school, Jay received a bright yellow backpack from his aunt. It looked ordinary, but it was not.
When Jay opened it in class, he found a pencil, a notebook, and a shiny red apple, even though he had packed nothing.
The next day he wished for a book about space. When he opened the backpack, there it was!
Jay soon learned the backpack only gave him things he truly needed. When he wished for a hundred sweets, it gave him just one.
'You only get what you need,' Jay thought. 'That is fair.'
Jay shared his apple with a new friend that day, and he decided the magic backpack was the best gift he had ever received.

books.title: The Magic Garden
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Behind Lila's house there was an old garden that nobody ever visited. The gate was rusty, and the plants had grown wild.
One morning, Lila found a small silver key under a stone. She tried it in the gate, and to her surprise, the lock opened with a click.
Inside the garden, the flowers glowed in every colour. When Lila watered them, they sang soft, happy songs.
Lila came back every day to care for the garden. She pulled the weeds, planted new seeds, and talked to the flowers.
Soon the whole village came to see the magic garden. Lila smiled, because she had turned a forgotten place into the most beautiful garden in the world.
